```{r}
library(tidyverse)
original_df <- read_csv("rpi_standings_all.csv")
df <- original_df |> 
  select(team, conference, season_year, rpi_rank, sos_rank, overall_w, overall_l, overall_t)
```
```{r}
num_teams <- 213
increment <- (num_teams-25)/4

champion_df <- df |> 
  filter(rpi_rank <= 10)

elite_df <- df |> 
  filter(rpi_rank > 10 & rpi_rank <= 25)

first_quarter_df <- df |> 
  filter(rpi_rank > 25 & rpi_rank <= (25 + increment))

second_quarter_df <- df |> 
  filter(rpi_rank > (25 + increment) & rpi_rank <= (25 + 2*increment))

third_quarter_df <- df |> 
  filter(rpi_rank > (25 + 2*increment) & rpi_rank <= (25 + 3*increment))

fourth_quarter_df <- df |> 
  filter(rpi_rank > (25 + 3*increment))
```
